title: Verify enrollment recovery after process termination
description: Exercise the experimental enrollment boundary with synthetic card bytes and provider adapters. Kill a separate OS process during reader I/O, identity I/O and after completion; reopen the same SQLite store and verify retained state, replay rejection without provider calls, and a fresh enrollment. Run only on GitHub-hosted Ubuntu and Windows.
acceptance_criteria: Hosted Ubuntu and Windows evidence identifies the source revision and confirms process termination, persisted processing/completed state, same-request rejection without provider replay, and successful fresh enrollment. Record limits: no power-loss, remote provider reconciliation or production recovery claim.
notes: 2026-10-19: Reviewed PR #7 at 0f8fb373139559129cc065a3ff0c1c9588b79ed5 and merged as da32d08922f34f274398395e1755d7afcaa3adbb. Merge tree matches the reviewed head. Hosted post-merge run 39271439597 also passed Ubuntu, Windows and Chromium jobs. No local test execution.

OS kills at reader, identity and completed checkpoints preserved expected state; reopened stores rejected replay without adapter calls and allowed fresh enrollment. Evidence: docs/enrollment-recovery-validation.json and docs/ingestion-validation.md. No local tests; power-loss and real-provider recovery remain outside scope.

title: Establish an authoritative driving-entitlement status source
description: Investigate access to suspension, cancellation and expiry status, eligibility, contracts, freshness and outage behavior. Distinguish on-card expiry and JPKI certificate revocation from current driving entitlement.
acceptance_criteria: Confirm an authoritative usable interface and access conditions, or record the unresolved source and prohibit claims of live status verification.
notes:
Initial NPA/JSDC/JPKI source review recorded in docs/real-license-integration.md. No usable current driving-status API/access conditions confirmed. Historical certificates and JPKI certificate status are not live driving-entitlement checks. Provider follow-up is still required.
2026-10-16: Confirmed JSDC corporate application scope and groupware delegation procedure; these issue historical certificates and do not establish a real-time suspension/revocation API. NPA 2025-03-10 notice describes presenting the card for record erasure after suspension/cancellation/expiry, so signed chip contents alone do not establish fresh status. Provider eligibility, consent/purpose, state semantics, latency, price and outage behavior remain open. No inquiry sent.
2026-10-16 follow-up: Compared the official personal My Number licence display manual with the current public Mynaportal API catalogue and the June 2026 self-information item table. No driving-licence status item was identified in those published lists; private or separately contracted interfaces remain unconfirmed. The SMBC/ams March 2026 release describes chip-to-business-system real-time transfer, not a police suspension/cancellation query. Added questions on an authorized interface, eligibility, consent, authoritative source, status meanings, freshness and outage handling. No provider contacted or application submitted; live_licence_status_checked remains false.
2026-10-16 follow-up: JSDC certificate descriptions distinguish driving records, current points, and licence history including current categories/acquisition dates as well as past cancellations/expirations. These should not all be described as historical-only, but published certificate scope and delivery procedures still do not establish a real-time entitlement API or freshness SLA. The implemented AnonCreds revocation is synthetic application state only; live_licence_status_checked remains false. No inquiry sent.
2026-10-17: NPA/prefectural personal-information file registers identify driving-status data owners and routine transfers, not private API authorization. Public Mynaportal items still do not establish licence-status access. Added official contact routes and concrete eligibility/freshness questions to docs/real-license-integration.md. No inquiry or application sent; live status remains unconfirmed.
2026-10-18: Reviewed the NPA Mynaportal-licence linkage terms published by Okinawa Police, dated 2026-03-27. Section 2(2)(1) excludes licence information confirmation while suspended/provisionally suspended; section 7 prohibits off-purpose and non-holder use; section 9 permits unannounced interruption. These terms do not authorize a third-party proxy lookup, and screen availability is not a reliable entitlement status result. Public third-party API eligibility, consent/purpose, freshness and outage semantics remain unconfirmed. Added source and limits to docs/real-license-integration.md; no inquiry sent.
2026-10-19: JSDC public sources distinguish anonymized corporate analysis, electronic driving-history applications and electronic traffic-accident certificates; none establishes a live individual entitlement API. Corporate delegation also covers specific receipt/use/analysis consent beyond the demo sharing choice. Current ams page describes chip-field transfer with individually agreed destinations/items; the previously recorded validity-check phrase was not found in the retrieved current text, so docs now state the confirmed scope without claiming feature removal. Third-party eligibility, authoritative state semantics, reference time and freshness remain unresolved; no inquiry sent.
2026-10-19: NPA circular 35 dated 2025-03-13, section 9, PDF page 20, specifies internal disposition registration normally on notice delivery date and shortening registration normally on decision date. This does not establish private query access, external propagation delay or freshness guarantees. Added source and explicit distinction to docs/real-license-integration.md in PR #7; usable private live-status source remains unconfirmed.
2026-10-19 follow-up after PR #7 review: A bounded search found no new primary evidence for private-service live suspension/cancellation query permission or external propagation deadlines. JPKI certificate status and electronic vehicle-inspection APIs do not establish driving-entitlement status access. Existing unresolved conditions remain; no contact or application was made.
2026-10-21 public-source follow-up: Fukushima Police circular dated 2025-05-13, section 2.2(1)e(a)a, explains that renewing only the My Number licence record can leave the conventional card expired while the licence itself remains effective; section 2.1(5) separates My Number card invalidity from licence-record validity. Do not infer loss of all driving entitlement from one card expiry. TRUSTDOCK advertises IC/selfie matching in about 45 seconds, not a confirmed administrative suspension/cancellation query or freshness guarantee. Private query access remains unconfirmed; no contact/application. Sources and limits in docs/real-license-integration.md.

Private entitlement-query eligibility remains unconfirmed; no inquiry/application. Primary links in docs/real-license-integration.md.

No new usable private licence-status access conditions established; no inquiry sent. See the new source/version section of docs/real-license-integration.md.
